race.description: Allwood Stud Farm 2yo Westbred C&G Classic Final (G1)
race.comment: IGNITE THE FURNACE (1) has been very good from wider barriers so far this campaign. Kicked off the prep with back-to-back placings, one of them in the Diamond Classic from the outside barrier, before working to the front and going on to score here last time. At his peak and he has the speed to take advantage of the ace draw. HEZ THE BOSS (4) maintained the perfect record at this circuit and distance when he led from a similar barrier and went on to score by 5m last start. That was his eighth win on the trot, highlighted by his defeat of IGNITE THE FURNACE in the Diamond Classic. Draws wider than that rival but winning form is impossible to knock. Last-start winner IDEAL WHISPER (7) draws wider but has yet to miss the top-two this time in and split the top selections in the Diamond Classic prior. Looks a gap to the others, TERBIUM (10) could be next best.
